final_response: Reply sent to `customer@client.com` apologizing for the login failures and assuring them it's being treated as high priority.

args.body:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for reaching out, and we sincerely apologize for the disruption caused by the login failures your team is experiencing. We understand how critical access is to your operations, and we are sorry for the impact this is having on your work.

We are treating this as a high priority and are actively investigating the issue. We will keep you updated on our progress and work to restore access as quickly as possible.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need further assistance in the meantime.

Best regards,
Support Team
